contract: Default Frappe Desk controls and stylesheet only; no Cutting CSS, no extra subtitle; Vietnamese/English shared catalog.

accessibility.evidence: All public input/select controls have explicit labels. Device setup opens in a labeled dialog, focuses the device ID, and restores focus to its trigger on close. Label contrast 7.81:1, primary button 17.93:1, green status 4.54:1. Desk report selects have aria-labels.

responsive.evidence: Rendered all three target sizes. Document scrollWidth equals viewport width; wide records remain inside table-responsive.

loading.evidence: Slow 3G snapshot displayed the localized loading status while retaining the approved device and cached rows.

empty.evidence: Unregistered tablet shows no records and disabled entry controls; live Desk report shows the native empty message.

error.evidence: Invalid master selection displays a localized validation error; offline sync displays a localized retained-queue error.

partial.evidence: Offline screenshot retains cached catalog and synchronized rows alongside one pending local row.

success.evidence: Reconnect automatically drained the queue to zero; API returned exactly the new row with quantity 4 and an ISO UTC timestamp. Desk Restore produced the fourth audit action.

permission.evidence: Unapproved entry is disabled in the public UI. Backend integration tests reject a Pending device and anonymous reports. Manager can open its own native import form.

renderedEvidence.observation: Single column native controls and retained offline queue; records table scrolls internally.
Cutting entry form stays in the left panel; saved records use the right panel and an internally scrolling table.
Narrow entry panel on the left; saved records and table on the right; device registration is in the header settings dialog.
